name: IL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ford's large fundraising edge over Koppie
Open seat after Danny Davis's retirement
model.rationale: The D+34 fundamentals make this a deep-blue Chicago seat, and markets price a Democratic hold near certainty. Ford's fundraising advantage and Koppie's negligible cash on hand reinforce that the only real question is the Democratic primary, not the general.
model.watch: A surprise in the March Democratic primary, or an unexpectedly strong third-party or independent showing, would be the main way this race tightens.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Danny Davis (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Danny Davis's retirement opens a heavily Democratic Chicago-area seat that has voted Democratic by wide margins for decades. La Shawn Ford enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised over $700,000, while Republican Chad Koppie has raised only about $55,000 and reports almost no cash on hand. Outside spending has also flowed against the Republican side.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, consistent with the district's strong partisan lean. The general election is not expected to be competitive; the meaningful contest was the Democratic primary. The forecast holds the seat as Safe D, with modest uncertainty reflecting the open-seat transition and absence of polling.
